title: Defend the Faith and Show Mercy
summary_text: Jude warns of intruders who twist grace into permission for sin and deny Jesus Christ. He recalls God's judgments on unbelievers, angels, and cities that pursued strange flesh, showing the intruders' coming condemnation. Their empty words and greed match Enoch's warning about judgment on ungodly sinners. Believers must guard the saints' holy faith, heed the apostles, pray in the Spirit, and show mercy while awaiting Christ's eternal life. Jude ends by praising God, who can keep them from falling and bring them into His glory.
key_points: Jude calls for defense of the faith against intruders who misuse grace and deny Jesus Christ.
Jesus destroyed those He freed from Egypt who later disbelieved; Michael's dispute over Moses' body contrasts with the intruders' slander.
Enoch prophesied judgment on their wickedness, while images of useless clouds, dead trees, wild waves, and wandering stars expose them.
Remembering the apostles, believers must grow in faith, pray in the Spirit, and seek others' salvation with mercy and care.
Jude praises God's power to guard believers and bring them unblemished into His glorious presence.
